head_coach.name: Amir Ghalenoei
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic defensive-minded structure built around defensive organization, direct attacking transitions, and quick counters, shifting to a 4-4-2 or a 4-5-1 hybrid setup.

key_players.name: Mehdi Ghayedi
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 4 goals and provided 6 assists in 20 matches for Al-Nasr SC in the 2025/26 UAE Pro League. Known for pacey dribbling, clinical crossing, and vertical transition threats.

key_players.name: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 17 goals in 28 matches for Tractor FC, leading the Persian Gulf Pro League as top scorer in 2024/25. Highly versatile forward with strong link-up play.

key_players.name: Mehdi Taremi
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 10 goals in 24 appearances for Olympiacos in the 2025/26 season. Hard-working striker and team captain who excels at making runs behind the defensive line.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) in his left knee sustained in May 2026, ruling him out of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Omitted and excluded from the final 26-man World Cup squad following political controversy and alleged disloyalty linked to his social media posts.
